lines.text: This blade has a dark past.
It has shed much innocent blood.
You're a fool for traveling alone, so completely unprepared.
You're lucky your blood's still flowing.
So what brings you to the land of the gatekeepers?
Someone very dear, a kindred spirit, a dragon.
A dangerous quest for a lone hunter.
I've been alone for as long as I can remember.
Shh, shh, shh. We're almost done. Hey, sit still.
You are closer than you know.
Come take my journey in tonight
Come be my shadow, walk at my side
And when you see all that I have seen
Can you tell me now from time
I have been waiting all this time
For one to wake me, one to call mine
So when you're here, all that you hold dear
Do you fear what you will find?
'Cause the dawn breaks through the night
I'm alone forever longing for the home
I will be listening for the drum to call me over far away from my tender youth and the very truth, showing me what I've begun.
As the time breaks through the night
